content:
t7 is yours and it is now unblocked (t3 and t6 are both completed and I verified both myself). claim_task t7 and go.

Everything it needs already exists — do not re-implement any of it:
1. `CONTENT.STORY` is live in content.js with this exact shape: `{ title, premise, beats[7] {stage, line}, ending {line, text} }`. I verified all 7 beat.stage ids match CONTENT.STAGES[i].id element-wise, so you can index them positionally. Nothing reads STORY yet — it is inert until you render it.
2. `UI.showCard` / the museum detail panel from t2 are live and working; I verified the detail page myself (`#museumDetail`, mdImg/mdName/mdEn/mdJyut/mdTags/mdMemWrap/mdUseWrap/mdFactWrap/mdOwnerWrap/mdBack). Do NOT rebuild the detail page. t3 filled in year/use/fact, and I confirmed all four blocks now render as SHOWN.
3. The 拍機 meter from t4 is live and fed from main.js; do not touch it.

What t7 actually owes the user, from their own words: 「i want a short and memorable story as the story line」 and 「for those collection, please let user to watch and know more in the collection page」.

So:
A. Surface the story where a player will actually meet it. The natural places are the start screen (title + premise sets the tone before the first coin) and each stage-done card (the beat for that stage). Make it skippable and cheap — it must not block play, and it must not fire on every visit once it has been seen. Persist what has been seen in the same localStorage save you already handle (`yatmungai.save.v1` is the existing key — read the current code, do not guess the name).
B. The ending needs somewhere to land. When the last stage completes, the ending pair should be the thing the player reads, not a generic 恭喜. If a stage-done card already exists, extend it rather than adding a second competing modal.
C. Make sure the story and the collection detail work on a phone: the museum is already responsive, so check the story surface at 390x844 too.

Constraints: index.html, ui.js, and main.js are fair game for you, but main.js is the one file three tasks have touched — re-read it before editing and keep the 拍機 wiring and the probe keys intact. Do not edit content.js, sim.js or render.js (physics is actively editing render.js for t8 right now).

Acceptance: node --check on every file you touch exits 0; node tools/selftest.mjs 13/13; a CDP run proving the story appears at the right moment and can be skipped and does not reappear after being seen; the ending renders on last-stage completion; no console exceptions; and a phone-width screenshot of whatever you add.
